decisions: Keep the three current native values, selected exact n, scalar summary and uncertainties unchanged.
Do not transplant prior dissertation triplicate method or Table2.2 mean/SD into current Table4 scalar records.
Operational day39 and similar melting peaks do not establish identical aliquots, run identity or version equivalence.
Numerical differences do not prove independent experiments, erroneous current values or a basis to average or replace them.
Before admitting any prior-version data, obtain a verifiable full-text copy and visually check the table, footnotes, identity, method, license and publication-version relationship.
